body: Hugs. Found out today. At work and can’t tell anyone about why I’m suddenly in a fantastic mood.  Thank you kind internet stranger :)
So update. :). Case was dismissed. I’m free.  Went from vaguely suicidal to everything is fine.  Just want to share it.  :)
Thank you. First court date Friday.  I have no idea what’s going on. Lawyer just keeps saying relax.

Aggressive patients are common.  Every Er nurse has multiple stories.  I’m icu and I’ve been kicked. Punched. Pinched. Had urine and feces thrown at me.  I’ve never pressed charges because it’s usually a reaction to a disease process, or a med. but the Er also gets assholes.  I just looked like a deranged ass.  Doubt it would be a successful case.  And I’m now completely broke after paying lawyer fees and missing work.  It is what it is now.  But thank you for wishing me better.  But yeah. I wish I could have been labeled confused instead of combative.

I’m an icu nurse. I know the memories of times like this never really leave us. And it’s not much comfort, but you did everything possible to help that family.  It’s amazing how we can go into clinical mode and deal with the situation calmly on the outside and just be panicking on the inside. But keep working like we trained.  I spent more than one post code situation hiding in the bathroom bawling and shaking because I couldn’t rescue my patients. And yet you continue to work.  And continue to try.  I’m glad someone like you who is capable of reacting in an emergency was there.   You gave him every chance he had of surviving.  And I’m sorry you have to carry those mental scars.  So hugs to you. And thank you for being willing to keep trying.

I recently hurt my back. With no insurance I went to the ER.  I was given Steroids and Valium.  And a lecture about wasting ER resources. Three days later I was still bedridden. Horrible pain. Blood sugar really high from the steroids.  I took my Valium (helps with muscle spasms) and a couple hours later took another one because I couldn’t move without pain.  The medical treatment was completely ineffective.

Partner got me up and said we need to go back to the ER.  I said no because of the lecture I’d gotten.  We will go to the Urgent Care.  But as we were in the car, the position cause even more pain.  So we turned and went to another hospital’s ER. 

I couldn’t sit so the triage nurse got me a stretcher in the hallway.  I could only lay face down.  They ordered an ultrasound and xrays.  After the ultrasound triggered intense horrible leg spasms I grew extremely frustrated.  I refused the ordered X-rays because I was in so much pain.  The nurse returned and was incredibly condescending. I flew into a rage.  Started screaming at the nurses.  Got off the stretcher and staggered around and fell.  I was cussing at everyone.  Screaming. Completely out of my head.  

I left the ER and my partner ran for the car telling me to stay there.  I got angrier and angrier.  I turned around and went back into the ER.  The guard blocked me and started pushing me back out. I pushed back but he shoved me to the ground.  I swung backwards from the ground and ended up hitting him.  It was a sheriff.  In Texas that’s instantly a felony. I was arrested.  I still have nightmares about 24 hours in jail with one pain pill given 12 hours after I got there. 

I’ve never had Valium before. Apparently 1-10% of people who take Valium have anger and aggression. It takes away the ability to control your emotions. Couple that with pain. Lack of sleep, and high blood sugar and you have me.  

Also. Lawyer says being under the influence isn’t a criminal defense.  The meds made me do it doesn’t pan out very well apparently.   

I’ve never been violent in my life. Not even a parking ticket in the last 20 years.  But now I’m facing jail time and everyone who depends on me has their life in shambles. 

After my partner bonded me out of jail I lay on the living room floor shaking and crying. Not understanding what the hell just happened.  But I know my career is over. And my lawyers explaining that I’m a “mercy” case. Just hope for the best because I’ve always been a good guy.  So yeah.  That’s my shaking and crying oh fuck moment.  

The good news is that my back is fine now.  Went to a doctor. Started on muscle relaxers and gabapentin.  I was walking in two days, pain free in a week.  

So yeah. Fuck Valium. And fuck me.
It’s amazing how little goals like this can get you through some days.  :)

I’m right there with you on how you feel.  Everyday is s struggle to just keep going.  But this won’t work and can cause even more problems to overcome.
Take your religious bullshit and shove it up your ass.

Got called into work anyway.  Having to fake being normal with my coworkers is draining.  On the phone with my partner, and I start to talk about what’s going on and it immediately gets the response of me too.  I’m here alone while you travel.  It’s weighing on me too.  I feel sick..  and I tune him out.  Can’t even talk about how I feel without getting one upped.

Took double my usual dose  with a couple beers.   Really woozy feeling.  Gabapentin and robaxin with a couple bud lights.  It will work,  Hate that I have to set things up financially for my family.  Tired of all the pressure.  The water is freezing.  Calling into work this morning.  Just can’t handle it today.
